fire: System F was discovered by logician Jean-Yves Girard and computer scientist John Reynolds.
The logician Kurt Godel proved the incompleteness theorems.
The mathematician Alonzo Church introduced the lambda calculus.
Logician Alfred Tarski defined truth for formal languages.
The computer scientist Robin Milner designed the ML type system.
Philosopher and logician Gottlob Frege invented predicate logic.
The logician Haskell Curry gave his name to currying.
Logician Gerhard Gentzen introduced natural deduction.
